description:
About our brand and products:

ALVARA is a nature-based vitality science company rooted in stewardship, ritual, and foundational vitality.

Our flagship product, MycoNectar™, is a raw honey formulation of 24 synergistic adaptogens, functional mushrooms, rare minerals, and superfoods — crafted to nourish the body’s foundational systems rather than chase individual symptoms.

Each jar is designed as a simple daily ritual: one spoonful on its own or stirred into warm water, tea, coffee, or a smoothie. MycoNectar is made for people who value intentional wellness, premium ingredients, and products with a deeper story behind them.

What makes us different:

MycoNectar is not another capsule, powder, or coffee alternative. It is a honey-forward daily vitality ritual carried in raw honey — a rare delivery system in the functional mushroom and adaptogen category.

What makes MycoNectar distinct:

  • 24 synergistic ingredients in one daily spoonful

  • Raw honey base instead of capsules or powders

  • Functional mushrooms, adaptogenic herbs, rare minerals, and superfoods

  • Small-batch crafted in San Diego

  • Formulated around ALVARA’s philosophy of foundational vitality

  • Premium, ritual-based positioning

  • Brand language grounded in trust, education, and non-hype communication

We are building a community around vitality, stewardship, and a more intentional relationship with nature.

How affiliates can earn:

Community Ambassadors earn commissions by sharing their unique affiliate link and/or discount code with their audience.

Tier 1 Community Ambassador commission structure:

Monthly Referred Net SalesCommission Rate
$0 – $99915%
$1,000 – $2,99920%
$3,000 – $9,99925%
$10,000+30%

Program details:

  • Base commission: 10%

  • Performance accelerator: up to 25%

  • Cookie window: 90 days

  • Payouts: monthly

  • Tracking: affiliate dashboard

  • Affiliate tools: discount code, digital assets, content prompts, monthly newsletter, and campaign updates

The more aligned education, storytelling, and authentic content an ambassador shares, the more opportunity they have to grow their monthly commission rate.

How to promote us:

The strongest way to promote MycoNectar is through authentic daily-life content, not hard selling.

Recommended content angles:

  1. Morning Ritual
    Show how MycoNectar fits into your morning — in coffee, tea, warm water, a smoothie, or directly from the spoon.

  2. What’s Inside
    Educate your audience on one or two ingredients at a time, such as Lion’s Mane, Reishi, Shilajit, Vital Clay, cacao, or raw honey.

  3. Ritual Simplification
    Share how MycoNectar helps simplify a fragmented supplement routine by bringing adaptogens, functional mushrooms, rare minerals, and superfoods into one daily spoonful.

  4. Raw Honey Delivery System
    Teach your audience why MycoNectar is different from typical capsule or powder formats.

  5. The Why Behind ALVARA
    Share the deeper mission: ALVARA exists to help people reconnect with vitality, nature, stewardship, and daily ritual.

Approved promotion channels include:

  • Instagram Reels, Stories, and posts

  • TikTok videos

  • YouTube Shorts or long-form reviews

  • Email newsletters

  • Blog posts

  • Community groups

  • Wellness events

  • Practitioner, studio, or coaching communities

  • Organic personal recommendations

All affiliates are expected to use clear affiliate disclosures and avoid medical, disease, cure, or guaranteed-result claims.

Other information:

We are looking for aligned Community Ambassadors who care about wellness, ritual, nature, vitality, and thoughtful communication.

This program is a strong fit for:

  • Wellness creators

  • Health-conscious lifestyle influencers

  • Yoga, breathwork, meditation, and movement guides

  • Fitness and performance communities

  • Holistic practitioners

  • Nutrition and wellness coaches

  • Coffee, tea, and ritual-based creators

  • Founders, creatives, and high-performance professionals

  • Community leaders with trust-based audiences

To participate, ambassadors must:

  • Apply through the official affiliate landing page

  • Complete social profile review

  • Complete the affiliate onboarding protocol

  • Review and follow ALVARA brand guidelines

  • Use approved product language and disclosures

  • Promote with honesty, care, and integrity

We do not support spammy promotion, exaggerated claims, fear-based selling, coupon abuse, or misleading health claims. ALVARA is a premium, trust-led brand, and our ambassadors are expected to represent that standard with care.
